I want to figure out how to write a research proposal for some device I want to create, but I also don't know how to do that! On a happier note, it's my sister's birthday! Happy birthday! She deserves all the good things the world has to offer.

This is also my first devlog ever... waw. Most of it was yap rather than real stuff but ykw a milestone is a milestone. If you made it this far, thank you for reading! I hope you have a great day. Music Rec: DARMA GRAND PRIX - Yorushika (It's a RADWIMPS tribute and I'm listening to it right now!)
